name: framepay-sdk
description: FramePay SDK prototype and frame-devnet development tooling

scripts.aqua:demo: bun run sdk:build && node scripts/aqua/demo.mjs --network devnet
scripts.build: lerna run build && bun run examples:typecheck
scripts.build:verify: lerna run build --skip-nx-cache && bun run examples:typecheck
scripts.poc:dev: bun run sdk:build && bun run --cwd apps/poc dev
scripts.poc:build: bun run privacy:build && lerna run build --scope @framepay/poc --include-dependencies
scripts.poc:typecheck: bun run sdk:build && bun run --cwd apps/poc typecheck
scripts.privacy:build: bun run sdk:build && bun run --cwd packages/privacy build
scripts.private:setup: bun run privacy:build && node scripts/private/cli.ts setup
scripts.private:build: bun run privacy:build && node scripts/private/cli.ts build
scripts.private:deploy: bun run privacy:build && node scripts/private/cli.ts deploy
scripts.private:demo: bun run privacy:build && node scripts/private/cli.ts demo
scripts.private:report: bun run privacy:build && node scripts/private/cli.ts report
scripts.private:contracts:test: bun run privacy:build && node scripts/private/cli.ts test-contracts
scripts.private:test:proofs: bun run privacy:build && node scripts/private/cli.ts test-proofs
scripts.web:test:privacy: bun run sdk:build && bun run --cwd apps/web test:privacy
